description: Calculate the exact exit price needed to hit a target PnL or ROE percentage. Edge cases: entryPrice, leverage and sizeBase above zero; targetMode pnl or roe, targetValue any number; fees 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005); a target that cannot be reached from this position is an error. Not covered: funding, slippage, liquidation before the target, and the chance that price gets there. Use when user asks "at what price do I take profit to make $500?" or "where should I set TP for 20% ROE?". Returns: targetExitPrice.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. For inverse, pnl-mode targetValue and outputs are in the base coin.

targetValue.description: Target value (USDT/coin for pnl mode, or %)

name: workflow.run_exit_target
